bio.text: Don Beyer is serving his sixth term as U.S. Representative from Virginia's 8th District and sits on the Ways and Means Committee.
He was Lieutenant Governor of Virginia from 1990 to 1998, the Democratic nominee for governor in 1997, and U.S. Ambassador to Switzerland and Liechtenstein under President Obama.
A graduate of Williams College, he has spent four decades building a family business in Northern Virginia after a summer job at a car dealership in 1974, and he lives in Alexandria.
